title: A small board opens a new field
subtitle: Opportunity AI: lower the cost of a first experiment, then learn from the hardware.

blocks.title: 1. Start with curiosity
blocks.text: An ESP32-S3 board with a touchscreen, connectivity and audio. Little embedded experience, and rusty C++.

blocks.title: 2. Make one thing observable
blocks.text: Use a coding agent to help build a small diagnostic: display pixels, read a touch, inspect a microphone signal.

blocks.title: 3. Explore what becomes possible
blocks.text: Try a calculator, a USB number pad, browser setup, or local speech commands. Keep each capability independently testable.

blocks.title: 4. Combine the pieces
blocks.text: The Codex monitor brings display, networking and audio together. A local computer bridge supplies agent status and routes messages.

blocks.title: The board gets the final vote
blocks.text: A successful build proves compilation. Device checks establish behavior. AI makes the experiment easier to start; evidence makes its lessons trustworthy.
